use serde::{Serialize, Deserialize};
use std::sync::Arc;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};

/// Precision modes supported by the grid
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum Precision {
    FP16,
    FP32,
    FP64,
    INT8,
}

/// NVIDIA Architecture identification
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum NvidiaArch {
    Pascal,
    Volta,
    Turing,
    Unknown(String),
}

/// Hardware node types in the grid
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub enum Hardware {
    Pascal,
    Turing,
    Volta,
    Xeon,
    TPU,
    RemoteNode,
    WebGpu,
}

/// Ban levels for node health
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]

/// Dispatch tier for task routing
#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]

/// Profile of a specific compute device

    pub name: String,
    pub arch: NvidiaArch,
    pub sm_version: u32,
    pub vram_total_mb: u64,
    pub vram_free_mb: u64,
    pub tflops: f32,
    pub bandwidth_gbps: f32,
    #[serde(skip)]
    pub utilization: Arc<AtomicU64>,
    pub socket_id: Option<u32>,
    pub has_f16: bool,
}

/// Summary of a GPU node for discovery
#[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
pub struct GpuNode {
    pub name: String,
    pub arch: NvidiaArch,
    pub sm_version: u32,
    pub features: Vec<String>,
    pub vram_mb: u64,
    pub bandwidth_gbps: f32,
}

/// Errors returned by the warp-grid system
#[derive(Debug, Error)]
pub enum Error {
    #[error("Device not found: {0}")]
    DeviceNotFound(String),
    
    #[error("Shader compilation failed: {0}")]
    ShaderCompileFailed(String),
    
    #[error("QUIC connection timeout")]
    QuicTimeout,
    
    #[error("Node is KLined")]
    KLined,
    
    #[error("VRAM exhausted")]
    VramExhausted,
    
    #[error("NUMA topology mismatch")]
    NumaMismatch,
    
    #[error("IO Error: {0}")]
    IoError(#[from] std::io::Error),
    
    #[error("Parse Error: {0}")]
    ParseError(String),
}

use std::fs;
use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::atomic::Ordering;
use tracing::{info, warn};
use libc::{cpu_set_t, sched_setaffinity, pthread_self};
use crate::types::Error;

/// Represents the NUMA topology of the system
pub struct NumaTopology {
    pub socket_count: usize,
    pub gpu_affinity: Vec<(u32, u32)>, // (gpu_index, socket_id)
    pub cores_per_socket: Vec<Vec<u32>>,
}

impl NumaTopology {
    /// Detects NUMA topology by reading /sys filesystem
    pub fn detect() -> Result<Self, Error> {
        let sys_node_path = "/sys/devices/system/node";
        
        // 1. Count NUMA nodes
        let node_dirs = fs::read_dir(sys_node_path)?
            .filter_map(|entry| {
                entry.ok().and_then(|e| {
                    let name = e.file_name().into_string().ok()?;
                    if name.starts_with("node") {
                        name.strip_prefix("node").ok()?.parse::<u32>().ok()
                    } else {
                        None
                    }
                })
            })
            .collect::<Vec<u32>>();

        let socket_count = node_dirs.len();
        
        if socket_count > 2 {
            warn!("Sub-NUMA Clustering (SNC) detected: {} nodes found", socket_count);
        }

        // 2. Discover GPUs and map to NUMA nodes
        let mut gpu_affinity = Vec::new();
        let pci_path = "/sys/bus/pci/devices";
        
        if let Ok(entries) = fs::read_dir(pci_path) {
            for entry in entries.flatten() {
                let device_path = entry.path();
                let vendor_file = device_path.join("vendor");
                
                if let Ok(vendor_bytes) = fs::read_to_string(&vendor_file) {
                    if vendor_bytes.trim() == "0x10de" { // NVIDIA Vendor ID
                        let numa_file = device_path.join("numa_node");
                        if let Ok(numa_str) = fs::read_to_string(&numa_file) {
                            if let Ok(socket_id) = numa_str.trim().parse::<u32>() {
                                // Assign a simple index based on discovery order
                                let gpu_index = gpu_affinity.len() as u32;
                                gpu_affinity.push((gpu_index, socket_id));
                                info!("Found GPU {} on Socket {}", gpu_index, socket_id);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // 3. Map cores per socket (simplified: read online_cpus)
        let mut cores_per_socket = Vec::new();
        for i in 0..socket_count {
            let node_path = format!("{}/node{}", sys_node_path, i);
            let cpus_file = format!("{}/cpu*/online_cpus", node_path);
            // Note: glob expansion is tricky in std, using a simpler heuristic or ignoring for P1 stub
            // For P1, we assume we just track the socket ID for pinning logic
            cores_per_socket.push(Vec::new()); 
        }

        Ok(NumaTopology {
            socket_count,
            gpu_affinity,
            cores_per_socket,
        })
    }

    /// Pins the current thread to a specific socket's cores
    pub fn pin_worker_to_socket(socket_id: u32, cores: &[u32]) -> Result<(), Error> {
        if cores.is_empty() {
            return Err(Error::NumaMismatch);
        }

        // Create CPU set
        let mut cpu_set: cpu_set_t = unsafe { std::mem::zeroed() };
        
        for &core in cores {
            unsafe {
                libc::CPU_SET(core as libc::c_int, &mut cpu_set);
            }
        }

        // Set affinity
        let ret = unsafe {
            sched_setaffinity(
                pthread_self(),
                std::mem::size_of::<cpu_set_t>(),
                &cpu_set,
            )
        };

        if ret != 0 {
            Err(Error::NumaMismatch)
        } else {
            info!("Thread pinned to socket {}", socket_id);
            Ok(())
        }
    }
}

pub mod types;
pub mod numa;
pub mod pool;
pub mod metrics;

use types::{DeviceProfile, NvidiaArch, Precision};
use numa::NumaTopology;
use wgpu::{Adapter, Features, Instance, RequestAdapterOptions};
use tracing::info;

/// Main entry point for the Warp Grid
pub struct WarpGrid {
    pub numa: NumaTopology,
}

impl WarpGrid {
    /// Initialize the grid, detecting NUMA topology and local GPU capabilities
    pub async fn new() -> Result<Self, types::Error> {
        // 1. Detect NUMA topology
        let numa = NumaTopology::detect()?;
        info!("NUMA Topology detected: {} sockets", numa.socket_count);

        // 2. Initialize WGPU to check F16 support
        let instance = Instance::new(wgpu::InstanceDescriptor::default());
        let adapter = instance
            .request_adapter(&RequestAdapterOptions::default())
            .await;

        let mut has_f16 = false;
        if let Some(adapter) = adapter {
            if adapter.features().contains(Features::SHADER_F16) {
                has_f16 = true;
                info!("WGPU Adapter supports SHADER_F16");
            } else {
                warn!("WGPU Adapter does NOT support SHADER_F16");
            }
        }

        // 3. Construct a dummy profile for the local node (P1 stub)
        // In a real implementation, this would iterate over detected GPUs
        let local_profile = DeviceProfile {
            name: "Local-Node-0".to_string(),
            arch: NvidiaArch::Unknown("Unknown".to_string()),
            sm_version: 0,
            vram_total_mb: 0,
            vram_free_mb: 0,
            tflops: 0.0,
            bandwidth_gbps: 0.0,
            utilization: std::sync::Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicU64::new(0)),
            socket_id: numa.gpu_affinity.first().map(|g| g.1),
            has_f16,
        };

        info!("Local Device Profile: {:?}", local_profile);

        Ok(WarpGrid { numa })
    }
}

use std::process::Command;
use crate::types::Error;

/// Metrics collected from a single GPU
#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct GpuMetric {
    pub gpu_index: u32,
    pub utilization_pct: u32,
    pub memory_used_mb: u64,
    pub memory_total_mb: u64,
    pub temperature_c: u32,
    pub power_draw_w: u32,
}

/// Queries GPU metrics using nvidia-smi
pub async fn query_gpu_metrics() -> Result<Vec<GpuMetric>, Error> {
    // Query: utilization.gpu, memory.used, memory.total, temperature.gpu, power.draw
    let output = Command::new("nvidia-smi")
        .args([
            "--query-gpu=utilization.gpu,memory.used,memory.total,temperature.gpu,power.draw",
            "--format=csv,noheader,nounits"
        ])
        .output()
        .await
        .map_err(|e| Error::IoError(std::io::Error::new(std::io::ErrorKind::Other, e)))?;

    let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
    let mut metrics = Vec::new();

    for line in stdout.lines() {
        let parts: Vec<&str> = line.split(',').collect();
        if parts.len() >= 5 {
            let util = parts[0].trim().parse::<u32>().unwrap_or(0);
            let mem_used = parts[1].trim().parse::<u64>().unwrap_or(0);
            let mem_total = parts[2].trim().parse::<u64>().unwrap_or(0);
            let temp = parts[3].trim().parse::<u32>().unwrap_or(0);
            let power = parts[4].trim().parse::<u32>().unwrap_or(0);

            metrics.push(GpuMetric {
                gpu_index: metrics.len() as u32,
                utilization_pct: util,
                memory_used_mb: mem_used,
                memory_total_mb: mem_total,
                temperature_c: temp,
                power_draw_w: power,
            });
        }
    }

    Ok(metrics)
}

/// Estimates register pressure by counting variable declarations in WGSL
pub fn estimate_register_pressure(wgsl_source: &str) -> u32 {
    let mut count = 0;
    for line in wgsl_source.lines() {
        let trimmed = line.trim();
        if trimmed.starts_with("var ") || trimmed.starts_with("let ") {
            count += 1;
        }
    }
    count
}
